status_note: PROPOSALS ONLY. Nothing on this list has been implemented. Each item needs a decision (approve, reject, or modify) before any change is made. Decisions are recorded on the page in your browser and can be copied into COORDINATION.md.

rows.title: Get an official, per-club depth-chart source (blocks the starter-vs-backup analysis)
rows.problem: No official depth chart was reachable for any club checked. NFL.com and the Commanders club page both returned 404. Third-party depth charts are not official, so no starter or backup value can be verified.

options.label: Capture each club's official depth chart weekly by hand from the club site or NFL.com, with a timestamp
options.con: 32 clubs x weekly labour; the paths were not found in this session

options.label: Scrape club-site depth-chart pages on a schedule
options.con: 32 different sites, fragile markup, terms of use not checked

options.label: Use third-party depth charts, labelled 'non-official'
options.con: Breaks the official-source rule; not verifiable

rows.recommendation: Option A now to prove the method on 4 clubs, then decide on B. Do not use C in verified tables.
rows.decision_needed: Which option, and which clubs first?

rows.title: Keep a timestamped weekly archive of the NFL.com injury report
rows.problem: The page text has no as-of time, and only one week is stored. Deficiency trends cannot be measured without history.

options.label: Manual weekly capture into nfl-command/data/raw/ with a fetch timestamp
options.con: Relies on someone doing it each week

options.label: Scheduled GitHub Action that fetches the report and commits a snapshot
options.con: Reachability of nfl.com from GitHub runners is not verified; the sandbox shell cannot reach it

options.label: A then B, once B's reachability is confirmed

rows.decision_needed: Approve the weekly capture schedule and whether to test a runner fetch.

rows.title: Reconcile injured-reserve and ruled-out players against the report
rows.problem: Three NFL.com news conflicts are unresolved: Jackson and Huntley (BAL) and Darnold (SEA).

options.label: Add an 'NFL.com news' column with a conflict flag, reviewed each week
Add an official IR or transactions feed to join against the report
Ask NFL.com or the NFL how the report treats IR and ruled-out players

rows.recommendation: Option A now, and C as a question (Q02).

rows.title: Define 'starter' and 'backup' using a source that is actually official
rows.problem: Without a definition, no starter-vs-backup claim can be checked. Snap counts and depth order come from different places, and only depth order is what the user asked for.

options.label: Starter = first on the official depth chart for the position (needs SUG-01)
Starter = most snaps in the official game book or NFL.com game stats
Starter = in the game-day lineup (NFL.com game-day inactives)
options.con: Only available on game day; the publication timing was not verified from an official page

rows.recommendation: Option A once SUG-01 is answered, with B as a cross-check.

rows.title: Make the Skill Lab reproducible
rows.problem: Re-running the Skill Lab on this branch changed 12 committed files. The two hash seeds tested give identical output, so the cause is the committed snapshot, not randomness. Counts moved by one (e.g. tickets 857 to 856).

options.label: Re-run under the CI Python version (3.12) and compare before any change
Regenerate and commit the outputs from CI, with a reproduce check
options.con: Changes published numbers; needs a review

options.label: Freeze the current committed numbers and state the snapshot date

rows.recommendation: Option A first, then B if the diff persists.

rows.title: Consolidate the nine other parallel site folders into one canonical site
rows.problem: The repo publishes nine other site folders besides the root Line Lab, each with its own numbers. The root Line Lab reports 0 of 7 candidates, and Skill Lab reports 0 of 16.

options.label: Make nfl-command the canonical site and link the others from its Repo review page
Archive the others with a notice, without deleting
options.con: Breaks any links people already have

options.label: Do nothing

rows.title: Keep leaderboard rewards at zero points until gates and legal review are both done
rows.problem: No strategy passes the gates, so nothing qualifies for a reward. Whether a prize leaderboard is allowed in Alberta has not been checked.

options.label: Zero-value points only; no cash until legal review
Prize pool, after review by AGLC or counsel
No rewards at all

rows.title: Source closing-line prices from an identified archive
rows.problem: Gate G10 needs recorded historical prices. The repo uses nflverse-derived prices, which are third-party. No official archive was identified.

options.label: Keep nflverse prices, labelled third-party, and show G10 as 'unverified'
options.con: G10 cannot pass with official evidence

options.label: License a closing-line archive and re-run the gates

rows.recommendation: Option A now. Revisit B when budget and terms are known.

rows.title: Add an injury feature to the origination model only after SUG-01 and SUG-02
rows.problem: The injury layer is not yet in the origination model. Adding it now would be untestable against history.

options.label: Report-only injury layer on the site for now
Pre-register an injury feature, then test it walk-forward

rows.recommendation: Option A now, B after both data sources exist.

rows.title: Decide how computed rows are labelled
rows.problem: Model and strategy rows are computed from third-party inputs, so they cannot have an official value source. They are shown with an 'UNVERIFIED-INPUT' flag and a method link.

options.label: Keep the numbers, flagged (current)
Blank the computed numbers until official inputs exist
options.con: Hides the analysis the request asked for

rows.recommendation: Option A, with the flag visible.
